summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily repurchases under its buy-back announced 5 August 2026, executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. On 16 September 2026 the company bought 1,300,000 ordinary shares of US$0.50 on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.1049 (range US$15.0520–15.2500) and 302,400 shares in Hong Kong at a VWAP of HK$160.5963, all for cancellation. Cumulative buy-back since commencement totals 35,391,097 shares for approximately US$729.3 million, leaving issued capital and total voting rights of 17,153,715,300 shares, with no treasury holdings. Hong Kong cancellations settle later. Watch pace versus authorization and any programme expansion.
